## open-primeagent

What agents have learned about this project, recorded so the next one does not rediscover it. The rules are written out to be followed by any agent that reads this file, with or without open-primeagent. Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema changes: regenerate models_gen.py** — - `schema.py` (`FIELDS`) is the source of truth for the User schema. - `models_gen.py` is generated from it. Never edit it by hand. After changing `schema.py`, run `python3 tools/sync_models.py`. - Run `python3 -m pytest -q`. `tests/test_schema.py` fails with "models_gen.py is stale" if the two files disagree. - Most other scripts in `tools/` are no-op stubs. `sync_models.py` is the one that does real work. - Use `python3`. The `python` alias may point to an interpreter that isn't installed.
<!-- opa:end -->
